properties.name: stats.writer.stat-type
properties.description: Which stat type THIS instance consumes (ADR-003 D8). One image, but one deployment per type, because per-type concurrency, prefetch and replica count are a MUST (STA-11A/20A/26A) and are only independently tunable if the instances are separate. 'all' is a development convenience; StatTypeDeploymentGuard refuses it under the prod profile. Declared here because it is read by name through @Value and Environment rather than bound to a @ConfigurationProperties class, so the annotation processor cannot see it.

properties.name: stats.retention.pre-create-on-startup
properties.description: Also pre-create partitions at startup, before the listener containers begin consuming. The daily cron is not sufficient alone: a module deployed at any other hour meets a parent table with no partitions and stays that way until 03:30, with every insert failing and every delivery correctly left unacknowledged until the consumer wedges. Set false ONLY where a separate job owns partition DDL. Declared here because PartitionBootstrap reads it through @ConditionalOnProperty, which the annotation processor does not generate metadata for.
